title: CircleSeeker
description: CircleSeeker is the PacBio HiFi analysis software developed for MMC-seq. It reconstructs extrachromosomal circular DNA using tandem-repeat evidence from CtcReads-Core and split-read evidence from SplitReads-Core. It reports unique-locus (UeccDNA), multi-locus (MeccDNA) and chimeric (CeccDNA) circles. A multi-locus call represents one sequence with several candidate source loci.
